Batch 85 is authored within the assigned scope: seven items, two YAML-only A/B pages, proof contracts, source evidence, dependency inputs, and seven Step-1 `ready` records with `owner:false`. The A page puts the projection lemma before the definition it justifies, removing a circular dependency. The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/machine-learning/rl-function-approximation-and-off-policy-limits.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/machine-learning/rl-function-approximation-and-off-policy-limits-examples.md), and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-85.notes.md) contain the work and reconciliation details.

The MRP proof finds a source-text discrepancy: Sutton and Barto’s exact objective gives the unique minimizer \((- \gamma/D,\gamma/(2D))\), with limit \((-1/3,1/6)\); the printed \((-1/2,0)\) is an endpoint minimizer at \(\gamma=1\), not that limit. The carrier proves the formula locally and records the issue for the owner. [Sutton and Barto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mutual-ai/Book/main/books/RL/RLbook2020.pdf) and the recovered [Hutter et al. author copy](https://www.hutter1.net/publ/rlwlinfa.pdf) are documented in the [source evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-85.source-evidence.json).

Scoped proof-layout, precheck, render, statement, content-policy, coverage, proof-contract, and source-fetch checks passed. Source fetch verified 6/6 page/source rows with no drops. All seven item dependency levels match the computed graph. The full-run dependency check remains open on 30 empty inventories outside this batch; the ordinary Step-1 snapshot shows all seven assigned records closed and ready. Autopilot remains at 73/101 pairs under the existing owner repair/recertification hold.
